message: Parameter `mask` of `declare function blend` is readonly u8[] in a run that `dst` opened as f32[]: the one count after a run is in elements, so every buffer of a run has the same element type; close the run with its count first

Parameter `src` of `declare function pack` is readonly u16[] in a run that `dst` opened as i32[]: the one count after a run is in elements, so every buffer of a run has the same element type; close the run with its count first
